method: Browser WebSocket opened from a page on the deployed app's own origin, https://effervescent-bubblegum-1e5c03.netlify.app (a CSP-free document, as in RD-PROBE-1 method 2).
purpose: WP25 part 2 build-time check: which Binance and Bybit liquidation websocket endpoints open from the app origin and actually deliver liquidation events.

binance_market_ws.note: Binance pushes only the latest liquidation per symbol per second, so totals are labelled 'sampled'.

binance_legacy_ws.decision: not used: the legacy /ws/ path opens but is silent

bybit_public_linear.decision: used (BYBIT_LIQ_URL); connected only after the subscribe acknowledgement; ping every 20 s

not_verified: terms of use and connection or message rate limits of the two streams beyond what the probe saw
